products.title: Mr. Pen- Abide Bible Study Journal – A5 Hardcover Journal with 136 Pages, 120gsm Paper, Gold Metal Spiral, Christian Gift for Women, SOAP Bible Study Method

description.html: Abide is based off John 15 where Jesus tells us that if we abide in Him and His word abides in us, we will bear much fruit. Studying God’s Word bears much fruit in our lives and this journal walks us through how to do that. "The goal of this journal isn’t to get through the Bible, it’s to get the Bible through us. This journal helps us slow down and notice things we sometimes miss when just reading the Bible, so we can catch what God is wanting to speak." - Kaci Nicole, Designer of the Abide Journal. Guided by SOAP Method: Scripture, Observation, Application, and Prayer, this simple, proven approach helps deepen your understanding of the Bible. Helps You Engage Deeply with Scripture: The SOAP method breaks down Bible study into focused steps, making it easier to understand, reflect on, and live out God’s Word in a personal and practical way. Elegant & Durable: Linen hardcover with gold embossed lettering and a gold metal spiral for a clean, modern look that lays flat, with 136 pages of thick A5 sized, 120gsm paper to minimize bleed-through and support daily use. Created in collaboration with Kaci Nicole: this journal makes Bible study approachable and doable. With simple instructions and room to reflect, it's a tool that empowers Christians of all ages to dig into Scripture systematically. Perfect Christian Gift: A thoughtful gift for women seeking to grow in faith, ideal for birthdays, holidays, or encouragement.
